title: Foundation or Formula? (full text, HTML v1): results
note: Worst ratio to scenario-best: TimesFM-3 1.31 (95% bootstrap 1.28-1.36); AutoARIMA 2.22 (2.07-2.38), AutoETS 3.50, Theta 4.69, seasonal naive 5.65. TimesFM-3 has the lowest mean MASE in 16 of 36 scenarios, AutoARIMA in 10. On D4 at n>=48 AutoARIMA mean MASE is 21-24% below TimesFM-3. Hypotheses: H1 not supported, H2 and H3 partly, H4 contradicted, H5 not supported.

title: Foundation or Formula? (full text, HTML v1): other models, real data, cost
note: Other models' worst ratios: TimesFM-2.5 2.18, TiRex 2.24, Chronos-2 2.75, Chronos-Bolt 3.06. M4 monthly: OWA 0.862, behind the top four (0.831-0.849). FRED-MD, 101 series, Jan 2025-Jun 2026, 18 steps: MASE 0.607 vs AutoARIMA 0.540, not significantly different. TimesFM-3 about 47 ms a series on a 12-thread CPU. Weights under a non-commercial licence. Several analyses are post hoc.

title: PREREGISTRATION.md
note: Protocol dated 2026-09-08, said to be frozen before any simulation result. Five directional hypotheses (H1-H5), no numeric thresholds. Weights google/timesfm-3.0-pytorch through timesfm 3.0.1, no revision given; zero-shot, univariate. Six methods, nine processes, four lengths, H=12, 7,200 series, MASE primary. The worst-case ratio is not among the planned outcomes.

title: results/summary.txt
note: Results file: 129,600 metric rows. Cell winners over 36 cells: TimesFM-3 16, AutoARIMA 10, seasonal naive 4, Theta 2, combination 2, AutoETS 2. title: Foundation or Formula? A Simulation-Based Comparison of Google's TimesFM-3 and Classical Time-Series Models
note: Preprint by Ebrahim, Ali and El-Kotory, v1 only (2026-09-30), stat.ME. TimesFM-3 against ARIMA, ETS and others on 7,200 series from nine known processes, 12 steps, protocol called pre-registered. Neither family dominates: TimesFM-3 at most 1.31 times the scenario-best error, each classical method at least 2.2 times somewhere; auto ARIMA 21-24% better on seasonal ARIMA data with 4+ cycles.

title: Foundation or Formula? (abstract, further points)
note: Abstract also says: the low worst case is specific to TimesFM-3 among five foundation models and holds only at short horizons; at steps 25-48 they forecast a decline on a flat saturating process; no advantage on intermittent demand; M4 monthly level with the 5th-7th M4 entries; level with classical methods on 101 macro series. Code and data: Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22681072.

title: Foundation or Formula? (full text, HTML v1): design
note: First 100,000 characters read. TimesFM-3 (330.7M parameters, released 2026-08-31) run zero-shot, univariate, no seasonal period given; classical methods (AutoARIMA, AutoETS, Theta, their combination, seasonal naive; StatsForecast defaults) got the true period. Processes D1-D9, lengths 24/48/96/200, H=12, 200 replications each, MASE primary. Protocol frozen 2026-09-08.
